primary_text: "Every time we bid on something a developer swoops in and outbids us by 200k." You're not imagining it. Developer activity in Melbourne's west has pushed small businesses out of the market. But off-the-plan is a different game. Our new Truganina warehouses let you buy direct at a set price — no auction, no competing bids, no heartbreak. Dozens of owner-occupiers have already secured units this way. Minutes from Princes Freeway, West Gate Tunnel, and Port of Melbourne. If you're tired of losing, change the game.
description: Dozens of owner-occupiers already secured units — no auction required.
